#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: bash install-lab2.sh /absolute/path/to/lab-st-2026\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
package_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
project_dir=$1
project_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$project_dir" && pwd)
test -f "$project_dir/common/graphic.c"
test -f "$project_dir/lab2/Makefile"
cmp -s "$project_dir/lab2/main.c" "$package_dir/lab2/main.c" || {
    printf 'lab2/main.c differs from the current course template; review before installing.\n' >&2
    exit 1
}
cmp -s "$project_dir/common/common.h" "$package_dir/common/common.h" || {
    printf 'common.h differs from the current course template; review before installing.\n' >&2
    exit 1
}
if cmp -s "$project_dir/common/graphic.c" "$package_dir/common/graphic.c"; then
    printf 'Prepared graphic.c is already installed.\n'
elif cmp -s "$project_dir/common/graphic.c" "$package_dir/original/common/graphic.c"; then
    backup_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/../lab2-backup-XXXXXX")
    cp -p "$project_dir/common/graphic.c" "$backup_dir/graphic.c"
    cp "$package_dir/common/graphic.c" "$project_dir/common/graphic.c"
    printf 'Original graphic.c backed up at %s\n' "$backup_dir/graphic.c"
else
    printf 'graphic.c has other changes; review them before installing this version.\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
record_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/../lab2-build-record-XXXXXX")
printf 'Build log: %s/build.log\n' "$record_dir"
{
    date -Is
    uname -a
    make -C "$project_dir/lab2" CC=gcc || exit $?
    file "$project_dir/out/lab2" || exit $?
} 2>&1 | tee "$record_dir/build.log"
printf 'Build finished. Run lab2 after restoring screen power and stopping the desktop.\n'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: bash run-lab2.sh /absolute/path/to/lab-st-2026\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
project_dir=$1
project_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$project_dir" && pwd)
test -x "$project_dir/out/lab2"
test -c /dev/fb0
test -r /dev/fb0
test -w /dev/fb0
record_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/../lab2-run-record-XXXXXX")
set +e
(cd "$project_dir/out" && ./lab2) >"$record_dir/run.log" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
printf 'Program exit status: %s\n' "$status" >>"$record_dir/run.log"
cat "$record_dir/run.log"
printf 'Run log saved at %s/run.log\n' "$record_dir"
printf 'Also photograph the physical screen to verify the drawing result.\n'
exit "$status"

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import datetime
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BUILD = ROOT / "build"
RESULTS = ROOT / "test-results"
PREVIEW = ROOT / "preview"
for directory in (BUILD, RESULTS, PREVIEW):
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--cc", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
compiler = Path(args.cc).resolve()
environment = dict(os.environ)
environment["PATH"] = str(compiler.parent) + os.pathsep + environment.get("PATH", "")

def execute(command, log_name):
    result = subprocess.run([str(item) for item in command], cwd=ROOT,
                            env=environment, capture_output=True,
                            encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=60)
    output = result.stdout + result.stderr
    (RESULTS / log_name).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    if output:
        print(output.rstrip())
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{log_name}: process exited with {result.returncode}")
    return output

original = (ROOT / "original/common/graphic.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
source = (ROOT / "common/graphic.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
header = (ROOT / "common/common.h").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
course = ROOT.parent / "course-source/lab-st-2026"
assert (ROOT / "lab2/main.c").read_bytes() == (course / "lab2/main.c").read_bytes()
assert (ROOT / "lab2/Makefile").read_bytes() == (course / "lab2/Makefile").read_bytes()

def remove_assignment_functions(text):
    start = text.index("void fb_draw_rect(")
    end = text.index("void fb_draw_image(", start)
    return text[:start] + "[LAB2 DRAWING FUNCTIONS]\n" + text[end:]

assert remove_assignment_functions(source) == remove_assignment_functions(original), \
       "A production function outside lab2 was modified"
patch = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(original.splitlines(True), source.splitlines(True),
                                   fromfile="original/common/graphic.c",
                                   tofile="common/graphic.c"))
(ROOT / "lab2-functions.patch").write_text(patch, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
defines = []
for name in ("SCREEN_WIDTH", "SCREEN_HEIGHT", "FB_COLOR"):
    match = re.search(r"(?m)^#define " + name + r"(?:\(|\s)[^\n]*", header)
    assert match, name
    defines.append(match.group())
globals_start = source.index("static int LCD_FB_FD;")
globals_end = source.index("void fb_init(")
globals_text = source[globals_start:globals_end]
globals_text = globals_text.replace("static int LCD_FB_FD;\n", "")
assert globals_text.count("static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];") == 1
globals_text = globals_text.replace(
    "static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];",
    "static struct {\n"
    "    int before[GUARD_WORDS];\n"
    "    int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];\n"
    "    int after[GUARD_WORDS];\n"
    "} TEST_BACK;\n"
    "#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels")
functions_start = source.index("static void _copy_area(")
functions_end = source.index("void fb_draw_image(", functions_start)
portable = (
    "#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>\n#include <string.h>\n"
    "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n"
    "#include <time.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n"
    + "\n".join(defines) + "\n" + globals_text
    + source[functions_start:functions_end])
(BUILD / "graphics-under-test.c").write_text(portable, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

flags = ["-std=c11", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
         "-Wno-unused-parameter", "-static", "-I", str(BUILD)]
test_executable = BUILD / "test-graphics.exe"
execute([compiler, *flags, ROOT / "tests/test_graphics.c", "-o", test_executable, "-lm"],
        "compile-tests.log")
unit_output = execute([test_executable], "offline-tests.log")
case_count = int(re.search(r"PASS: (\d+) offline cases", unit_output).group(1))

course_main = (ROOT / "lab2/main.c").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
course_main = re.sub(r"(?m)^#include[^\n]*\n?", "", course_main)
replay = r'''#include "fixture.h"
void fb_init(char *device)
{
    (void)device;
    reset_surfaces(0);
}
int32_t task_get_time(void)
{
    return (int32_t)((int64_t)clock() * 1000 / CLOCKS_PER_SEC);
}
unsigned int sleep(unsigned int seconds)
{
    (void)seconds;
    return 0;
}
#define main course_lab2_main
'''
replay += course_main
replay += r'''
#undef main
int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    require(argc == 2, "preview output path argument");
    printf("OFFLINE memory framebuffer replay; timing values are host-only.\n");
    int status = course_lab2_main(0, NULL);
    require(status == 0, "course main exit status");
    check_front_matches_back();
    write_preview_ppm(argv[1]);
    printf("PASS: original course lab2/main.c completed; preview written.\n");
    free(front_storage);
    return 0;
}
'''
replay_file = BUILD / "replay-course-main.c"
replay_file.write_text(replay, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
replay_executable = BUILD / "replay-course-main.exe"
execute([compiler, *flags, "-I", ROOT / "tests", replay_file,
         "-o", replay_executable, "-lm"], "compile-preview.log")
ppm_path = PREVIEW / "lab2-simulated.ppm"
execute([replay_executable, ppm_path], "course-main-offline.log")

from PIL import Image
with ppm_path.open("rb") as image_file:
    assert image_file.readline() == b"P6\n"
    dimensions = tuple(map(int, image_file.readline().split()))
    assert image_file.readline() == b"255\n"
    pixels = image_file.read()
assert dimensions == (1024, 600)
assert len(pixels) == dimensions[0] * dimensions[1] * 3
Image.frombytes("RGB", dimensions, pixels).save(PREVIEW / "lab2-simulated.png")

report = {
    "recordedAt": datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    "mode": "Windows-host C tests and memory framebuffer simulation",
    "offlineCasesPassed": case_count,
    "compiler": str(compiler),
    "compilerFlags": flags,
    "productionSourceSHA256": hashlib.sha256(
        (ROOT / "common/graphic.c").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "onlyLab2FunctionsChangedInGraphicC": True,
    "courseLab2MainAndMakefileUnchanged": True,
    "originalCourseMainCompletedInSimulation": True,
    "backBufferAndFrontBufferCanariesIntact": True,
    "paddedFramebufferStrideVerified": True,
    "hardwareValidated": False,
    "preview": "preview/lab2-simulated.png",
    "pending": [
        "ARM-native compilation on the Orange Pi",
        "Real framebuffer format and geometry check",
        "Physical screen verification and teaching-assistant acceptance"
    ]
}
(RESULTS / "offline-result.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

members = [
    "common/graphic.c", "common/common.h", "common/rules.mk",
    "original/common/graphic.c", "lab2/main.c", "lab2/Makefile",
    "lab2-functions.patch", "install-lab2.sh", "run-lab2.sh",
    "下一步操作.txt"
]
archive_path = ROOT.parent / "lab2-ready.tgz"
with tarfile.open(archive_path, "w:gz") as archive:
    for relative in members:
        archive.add(ROOT / relative, arcname="lab2-prepared/" + relative)
with tarfile.open(archive_path, "r:gz") as archive:
    assert archive.getnames() == ["lab2-prepared/" + item for item in members]
print(f"Ready source package: {archive_path.name}")
print("Hardware validation is pending; no board connection is used by this script.")
